messages:
Marco: Quick proposal — run a 90-day micro-commit private offer for SI-led POCs. HW partner co-funds months 1–3. Goal: reduce barrier from trial to committed SKU, speed conversion. Thoughts?

Anita: Love the idea. Do we have precedent for co-fund % and duration? Who owns the private-offer billing flow?

Marco: @Raj can confirm billing. High-level sketch: commit floor = $5k/mo for 3 months. Rebate ladder: 50% month1, 25% month2, 25% month3. HW partner covers 50% of rebate cost. SI gets a $2k onboarding stipend (one-time) out of partner co-fund.

Raj: Billing notes: marketplace private offers show as committed spend on invoice. We need partner acceptance + PO to bind. Also SKU mapping: must map commit SKU -> marketplace listing so consumption credits apply. Legal addendum required.

Oliver: From ops side, we need a clear usage->rebate mapping and an implementable weekly meter. Suggest we calculate credits monthly and apply to the next invoice. Example: credit = min(usage, commit_floor) * rebate_rate for that month. Need to surface sample numbers in tracker.

Sasha: Channel enablement — I'll own the one-pager for SI + HW detailing flow, examples, and FAQ. Also need a short flow diagram for sales/solutions.

LegalBot: Heads-up: include a rebate clawback clause if customer terminates <120 days. Also require export-control check for the HW partner depending on regions.

Anita: Renewal path? Propose auto-convert option: post-90d, offer 6m or 12m commit with graduated discounts. Customer gets an opt-in link during the last billing month.

Marco: Timeline ask: pilot launch in ~4 weeks. Key action owners: Raj: marketplace & SKU setup; Sasha: collateral; Oliver: billing calc + webhook; Anita: pricing slab + renewal path; LegalBot: draft addendum. @everyone please ack.

Raj: Ack — will spin up marketplace draft and call out PO/acceptance flow.

Oliver: Ack. I’ll drop a sample calc in the tracker later today. Snippet below: 
```
commit = 5000
rebate = [0.5, 0.25, 0.25]
credit = sum(min(usage_month[i], commit) * rebate[i] for i in range(3))
```

Sasha: Noted — one-pager draft by EOW. Will include sample numbers from Oliver when available.

Anita: :thumbsup: Looks good. Need to confirm partner co-fund approval process.

Marco: Thanks all — I’ll sync with the HW partner next Tue and loop in sales ops. Keep replies short so we can move to tickets.

Marco: (follow-up) also consider a soft cap on credits per customer to limit exposure. We'll define in addendum.
